knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The lesson says the client buys a system that runs when it should, with a report they can act on. Your hourly rate, kit and business age are not what is bought.

The lesson says a return-visit guarantee must be something you can deliver and afford, and that any extra guarantee should be limited to what you can keep. An open-ended or impossible guarantee does not meet this.

The lesson says not to promise water savings or a percentage reduction unless it has been measured and the evidence can be shown. A famous endorsement, a discount or no evidence does not support the claim.

practicalCriteria: Applies the step to a real or simulated business decision and records the outcome
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Written output of the step (plan, offer, log or record)
stopWorkCriteria: Not applicable: business guidance; stop if an offer would make an unsubstantiated or misleading claim
